accounting.actual_postwrite: Independent closure wrapper/audit must verify actual ledger readback, cap/roots/foreign body preservation, owner/group absence, attempt hashes, and a real postwrite census. Store that observation outside the ledger to avoid ledger-size recursion.
accounting.administrative_overage_behavior: Record both cap overage and physical-free shortfall; these do not authorize new work and do not prevent a durable dead-owner claim from being removed. Atomic write can still fail normally on actual IO exhaustion.
accounting.formula: observed_apparent_bytes + sum(full storage_bytes for every non-released record) + additional_requested_bytes
accounting.global_churn: Both global scans use existing finite named-root inventory semantics. Changed unrelated apparent bytes are reported rather than assumed equal; the outstanding-reservation delta must be exactly the selected original full claim.
accounting.post_projection: Embedded final_accounting is explicitly prewrite released-record projection from a fresh scan, not actual postwrite observation.

administrative_predicates: Exact expected retained record digest and reservation ID; roots/schema/cap authenticated through existing _read.
Attempt under an exact named root with unchanged directory device/inode and unaliased regular artifacts.
Absent original owner PID; all current and prior recorded process groups dead, including PID reuse refusal.
No external charges; explicit artifacts_durable=True; exact nonempty artifact hashes fsynced and directory fsynced.
Attempt inventory byte total no larger than original reservation.
Existing owner lock and atomic fsynced writer; no original PID adoption, lease acquisition, extra requested bytes, new reservation or output deletion.
Foreign record digest captured before administrative scans and preserved in the planned ledger.
Fresh full-claim census followed by a second fresh census on a deep-copy where only selected status is released; full original claim remains present in first census.
Recheck dead owner/groups, named roots, exact attempt identity and durable inventory after each census and before write.
Preserve the entire limit/schema/roots and each foreign record body; only existing closeout fields and v2 explicit-reconciliation evidence on selected record change.
One atomic ledger write; uncertainty after replace is reported without automatic rollback or overwriting new state.

authority_and_scope.live_application: Requires a fresh concrete protocol and independent review for the exact own 0350 retained claim, then actual postwrite audit. This design report does not itself authorize live application.
authority_and_scope.safe_source_work: The user asks to figure out storage remediation and continue. A reversible additive administrative API fix plus meaningful tests in an isolated worktree is within that scope.

baseline_test_gap.finding: Three existing production/cap-migration test cases still use a 140 GB expected constant although source current main is 145 GB. Do not disguise this baseline mismatch; recovery fixtures patch a test-local 100000 byte cap.

finding.deadlock: Existing recovery calls _account while the full retained claim is charged. _account refuses charged_bytes above the existing limit even when owner and child groups are dead and all artifacts are durable. One such claim can therefore prevent its own explicit closeout.

proposed_api.administrative_path: Use a recovery-local non-admitting census; no modification to DaemonResourceReservation._account, __enter__, check_usage, release, finalize, scheduler or cap.
proposed_api.default_path: Keep existing _account call, capacity cutoff, v1 receipt and release behavior.
proposed_api.invalid_values: Reject non-str and unknown values before constructing helper or opening the live lock.

validation_cases: Default recovery refuses an over-cap pre-census even when hypothetical release would fit.
Explicit administrative closeout succeeds with pre and projected post both over cap, preserving outputs and all foreign records.
Pre over cap/projected post fits, equality at cap, and under-cap explicit mode report accurate capacity flags.
Insufficient physical free remains reported; admin closeout never implies filesystem allocation or lease authority.
New __enter__ remains capacity-refused after admin closeout if post state exceeds cap; no new ledger record or scheduler lease.
No _account relaxation; no scheduler acquire or owner __enter__ within recovery.
All existing ambiguity tests run also through explicit policy: live/reused owner, current/prior group, wrong record/artifact/root inode/status/external charge/no assertion.
Attempt mutation during either census, added/removed inventory, and root identity changes refuse without ledger write.
Foreign record mutation injected during an admin census refuses without write.
Attempt exceeds original reservation refuses, including when above-cap admin mode was requested.
Unknown/non-str policy refuses without lock, ledger or helper mutation.
Changed global observed bytes are represented by separate fresh scans and correct full-claim delta; no false fixed-observed claim.
Atomic writer failure preserves primary exception; wrapper must distinguish before/after-write uncertainty without automatic rollback.
